blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods have enabled effective multi-view 3D reconstruction by predicting Gaussian primitives in a single forward pass. However, existing approaches predominantly adopt a pixel-aligned paradigm that predicts one Gaussian per input pixel, coupling the Gaussian count to the input resolution and number of views. This also leads to redundant primitives in textureless regions and insufficient coverage in geometrically complex areas. We present Anchor3DGS, a pose-free feed-forward 3DGS framework that replaces pixel-aligned prediction with a compact anchor-based representation. Guided by information entropy, our method places a set of 3D anchors in the scene, concentrating them in regions of higher visual complexity while maintaining broad spatial coverage. Each anchor performs occlusion-aware aggregation of multi-view image features, exchanges information with other anchors, and is decoded into a set of local Gaussians. A lightweight feature enhancement module further refines the coarse RGB output from Gaussian splatting and improves rendering fidelity. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmark datasets demonstrate that our Anchor3DGS achieves state-of-the-art novel view synthesis quality while only using an order of magnitude fewer Gaussian primitives.
blocks.zh: 近期的Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splating(3DGS)方法通过在单个前传中预言高斯原始人,使得多视图3D重建有效. 然而,现有方法主要采用像素相通的范式,预测每个输入像素有一个高斯人,将高斯人计数与输入分辨率和视图数相接. 这也导致无纹理地区出现冗余原始人,几何复杂地区覆盖不足. 我们提出Anchor3DGS,这是一个无外观的Feed-forward 3DGS框架,用紧凑的锚地代表取代像素相通的预测. 以信息 en为取向,我们的方法将一组3D锚地放入现场,将其集中在视觉复杂程度较高的区域,同时保持了广泛的空间覆盖. 每个主播都进行多视图图像特征的隐蔽-意识聚合,与其他主播交换信息,并被解码为一组本地高斯人. 轻量级特性增强模块可进一步完善高斯电镀出粗糙的RGB输出并改进渲染忠诚. 对各种基准数据集的广泛实验表明,我们的Anchor3DGS实现了最先进的新颖视图合成质量,而只使用数量级的更少的高斯原始人.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Reconstructing 3D scenes and synthesizing novel views from multiple 2D captures is a fundamental problem in computer vision and graphics, with broad applications in robotics, autonomous driving, gaming, and virtual reality.
The pioneering NeRF [ 19 ] represents scenes as an implicit radiance field optimized via volume rendering, while subsequent 3DGS [ 13 ] employs differentiable rasterization of anisotropic 3D Gaussians to achieve real-time, high-fidelity rendering.
Despite its success, standard 3DGS requires a time-consuming per-scene optimization process. To address this limitation, a growing line of work has explored feed-forward 3DGS reconstruction [ 4 , 6 , 34 , 7 , 32 ] , which trains generalizable models on large-scale datasets to directly predict 3D Gaussians from input views in a single forward pass. Recent advances have further eliminated the dependency on pre-computed camera poses [ 38 , 11 , 9 ] , enabling truly end-to-end reconstruction from uncalibrated images.

blocks.en: However, current feed-forward approaches adopt a pixel-aligned paradigm in which one Gaussian is predicted for each input pixel. While conceptually straightforward, this design suffers from three key limitations: (1) Redundancy —textureless or homogeneous regions consume as many Gaussians as detail-rich areas, yielding redundant primitives and wasted capacity; (2) Insufficient coverage —poorly observed regions cannot be faithfully reconstructed, since each Gaussian is predicted independently from a single pixel, without leveraging contextual information from well-observed neighbors; and (3) Input dependency —the total Gaussian count is strictly tied to the input resolution and view count rather than to the scene itself, preventing efficient reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 然而,目前的向导方式采用了像素相通的范式,其中预测每个输入像素都有一个高斯. 这种设计在概念上是直截了当的,但有三个主要的局限性: (1)冗余——无纹或同质地区消耗了像细节丰富的地区一样多的高斯人,产生了多余的原始人并浪费了容量;(2)覆盖面不足——观察不足的地区无法被忠实地重建,因为每个高斯人都是从一个像素中独立预测出来的,而没有利用观察良好的邻居提供的背景信息;和(3)投入依赖——整个高斯人计数严格地与输入解析度有关,而不能与场景本身有关,阻碍了高效地重建.

blocks.en: In this work, we present Anchor3DGS , a feed-forward framework that takes uncalibrated multi-view images as input and outputs 3D Gaussians of the scene (see Fig. 1 ). Our key insight is that a scene’s 3D structure has no intrinsic connection to the number of input views or pixels that happen to observe it. We therefore propose to lift Gaussian allocation into 3D space: we represent the scene with a set of anchors whose spatial distribution is guided by scene content, while the total number of anchors is a hyperparameter, independent of image resolution and view count.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出Anchor3DGS,这是一个以未校正多视图图像作为输入和输出的向导框架 现场3D高斯人(参见图一. 我们的关键见解是,一个场景的3D结构与偶然观测到的输入视图或像素的数量没有内在的联系. 因此,我们提议将高斯分配提升到3D空间:我们用一组锚来代表现场,其空间分布以场景内容为取向,而锚站总数则是一个超参数,独立于图像分辨率和取景计数.

blocks.en: Our framework consists of several key components: (i) Entropy-guided anchor sampling. Our 3D anchor sampling strategy simultaneously ensures broad spatial coverage of the scene and adaptively allocates more anchors to regions exhibiting higher visual complexity, as identified by local information entropy. Entropy automatically guides 3D anchors to where they are needed most: few anchors suffice for low-complexity regions ( e.g., white walls or sky), while many anchors concentrate on high-complexity regions ( e.g., intricate structures or rich textures). (ii) Multi-view anchor aggregation and local decoding. Each 3D anchor aggregates visual features from all input views under occlusion-aware weighting, and is decoded into a small set of neighboring Gaussians that represent its local 3D region. Anchors also exchange information with each other, allowing those in poorly observed regions to leverage the context from well-observed neighbors and still produce plausible appearances. In contrast, pixel-aligned methods often leave visible holes in such regions. (iii) Feature enhancement. Beyond standard attributes, each Gaussian is also assigned a feature vector. These features are later splatted and decoded by a lightweight network, which compensates for the high-frequency details missing from the coarse splatted RGB image.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架包括几个关键组成部分:(一) 环导锚取样。 我们的3D锚地采样策略同时确保了现场的广泛空间覆盖,并因地制宜地将更多的锚地分配给视觉复杂程度较高的区域,如当地信息 en所认定. Entropy自动将3D锚地引导到最需要的地方:很少锚地足够低复杂区域(如白墙或天空等),而许多锚地则集中于高复杂区域(如复杂结构或丰富的纹理等). (二)多景主播汇总和局部解码. 每个3D主播将所有输入视图的视觉特征从闭塞-意识分量下汇总,被解码为代表其本地3D区域的一小组相邻高斯人. 锚地者还相互交流信息,使那些在观测不良地区的人能够利用观察良好的邻居提供的背景,并仍然产生可信的外表。 相形之下,像素相通的方法往往在这些区域留下明显的孔. (三) 增强特性。 在标准属性之外,每个高斯人也被分配到一个特征矢量. 这些特性后来被一个轻量级网络所镀并解码出,这弥补了粗重被镀的RGB图像所缺失的高频细节.

blocks.en:
Extensive experiments across benchmark datasets validate the effectiveness of our method. In sparse-view settings (3 and 6 input views), Anchor3DGS significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art baselines. In dense-view settings ( 32 32 input views), Anchor3DGS achieves comparable rendering quality while requiring an order of magnitude fewer Gaussians. This demonstrates that a compact anchor-based representation can match the fidelity of pixel-aligned approaches with greater efficiency.
Our contributions can be summarized as follows: • We propose Anchor3DGS , a novel anchor-based feed-forward 3DGS framework that replaces the pixel-aligned paradigm with a compact anchor-based representation, decoupling the Gaussian count from input image resolution and the number of input views. • We introduce three key designs— entropy-guided anchor sampling , occlusion-aware anchor aggregation and local decoding , and feature enhancement —which together enable high-fidelity novel view synthesis with fine details. • We achieve state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmark datasets with substantially fewer Gaussians than existing methods, demonstrating that our method yields a more compact yet equally effective representation.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) [ 19 ] pioneered novel view synthesis by representing scenes as continuous density and radiance fields, and optimizing them via differentiable volume rendering. Despite subsequent improvements [ 27 , 17 , 2 , 20 , 42 , 12 ] , the expensive ray sampling in volume rendering still prevents real-time performance.
3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [ 13 , 33 ] instead represents scenes as explicit anisotropic 3D Gaussians and exploits differentiable tile-based rasterization, achieving real-time speed with superior quality.
However, both NeRF- and 3DGS-based methods require accurate camera poses, typically from a costly Structure-from-Motion (SfM) pipeline such as COLMAP [ 24 ] . To remove this dependency, several works [ 3 , 10 , 14 , 8 ] attempt to jointly optimize the camera poses and the scene representation.
Nevertheless, all these methods still rely on tedious per-scene optimization. In contrast, our Anchor3DGS directly predicts camera poses and 3D Gaussians in a feed-forward pass within seconds.
blocks.zh:
神经辐射场 (NERF) [19] 开创了新颖的取景合成,将场景代表为连续密度和辐射场,并通过可分量渲染来优化. 尽管后来有所改进[27,17,2,20,42,12],但体积渲染中昂贵的射线取样仍然会阻碍实时性能.
取而代之的是3D高斯平板化(3DGS) [13,33] 代表场景为显式异同位素3D高斯平板化并利用可分取的瓦片基光栅化,以优异的质量实现实时速度.
然而,基于NERF和3DGS的方法都需要准确的相机外观,通常来自昂贵的结构自动(SfM)管道,如COLMAP[24]. 为了去除这种依赖性,多部作品[3,10,14,8]试图联合优化相机的姿势和场景表现.
尽管如此,所有这些方法仍然依赖于乏味的人均场景优化. 相比之下,我们的Anchor3DGS直接预测相机姿势和三维高斯人,在数秒内通过一个向后传.

blocks.en:
Feed-forward novel view synthesis avoids per-scene optimization by learning generalizable priors from large-scale datasets. Early works [ 40 , 29 , 5 ] condition the NeRF representation on image features aggregated from input views, enabling cross-scene generalization without per-scene retraining.
Following the success of 3DGS, subsequent feed-forward works [ 26 , 4 , 6 , 7 , 34 , 32 , 31 , 41 ] replace NeRF with explicit Gaussian primitives for higher rendering quality and faster speed. As representative examples, pixelSplat [ 4 ] employs epipolar attention to infer a dense depth probability distribution for predicting 3D Gaussians from image pairs, whereas MVSplat [ 6 ] incorporates multi-view stereo principles by constructing explicit cost volumes for more accurate geometric reconstruction.
A recent line of pose-free feed-forward methods [ 38 , 44 , 37 , 11 ] further eliminates the reliance on known camera parameters. By leveraging robust geometric priors from 3D foundation models [ 30 , 28 ] , FLARE [ 44 ] and AnySplat [ 11 ] can simultaneously infer the camera poses of input images and the matching geometry-aligned 3D Gaussians.
Despite these advances, all aforementioned feed-forward 3DGS methods typically predict Gaussians in a dense, pixel-aligned manner, resulting in massive redundant Gaussians. Although AnySplat [ 11 ] applies post-hoc voxelization for Gaussian reduction, this fails to address the root cause, and the remaining Gaussians are still far from compact. Instead, we decouple Gaussian allocation from the pixel-aligned paradigm and model the scene using a compact set of 3D anchors. A few concurrent works [ 1 , 22 ] also attempt to explore compact representations using learnable tokens, whereas we explicitly leverage 3D scene structure and visual complexity to guide Gaussian allocation.
blocks.zh:
Feed-forward 小说取景合成通过从大型数据集中学习通俗前科,避免了人均场景优化. 早期的作品[40,29,5]将NERF在从输入视图汇总的图像特征上的表现作为条件,使得跨场面的通俗化,而无需每个场面的再培训.
在3DGS成功后,后续的Feed-forward工程[26,4,6,7,34,32,31,41]用明确的高斯原始来取代NERF,以提高渲染质量和更快的速度. 作为代表性的例子,像素Splat [4] 利用极地注意力来推断出从图像对相中预测出3D高斯人密度的深度概率分布,而MVSplat [6] 通过构建清晰的成本量来更精确地进行几何重建,纳入了多景立体原理.
近代一行的无相机回馈法[38,44,37,11]进一步消除了对已知相机参数的依赖. 通过利用从3D基础模型[30,28]得到的强几何前身,FLARE [44]和AnySplate [11]可以同时推断输入图像的相机外观和相匹配的几何相通的3D高斯人.
尽管取得了这些进步,上述所有向导的3DGS方法一般都以密集,像素相通的方式预测高斯人,导致大量冗余高斯人. 虽然AnySplatz [11] 应用后热活化法来进行高斯还原,但这未能解决根源问题,而剩下的高斯人还远非紧凑. 相反,我们将高斯分配从像素相通范式中解析出来,并使用一套紧凑的3D锚地来模拟现场. 少数并发作品[1,22]也尝试用可学习的符号来探索紧凑的表示,而我们则明确利用3D场景结构和视觉复杂性来指导高斯分配.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: The key idea of our method is to represent the scene with a compact set of 3D anchors, rather than being strictly bound to the input image pixels. Each anchor represents a local 3D region: it is placed on a geometry-aware scene scaffold, gathers information from multiple views, exchanges information with other anchors, and is finally decoded into a set of local Gaussians. In this way, the scene representation is organized directly in 3D space, with its size controlled by the anchor budget.
blocks.zh: 我们方法的关键理念是用紧凑的3D锚地来代表场景,而不是被严格绑定在输入图像像素上. 每个锚代表了当地的3D区:被放入了几何感知场景脚手架上,从多种观点中收集信息,并与其他锚地交换信息,最终被解码为一组当地的高斯人. 这样,场景表现直接由3D空间组织,其大小由主播预算控制.

blocks.en: 3.1 Pose-Free Geometry Initialization
blocks.zh: 3.1 Pose-Free几何初始化

blocks.en: Before constructing anchors, we first build a geometry-aware 3D scaffold of the scene. The role of this stage is to lift the uncalibrated input images into a consistent geometric space on which anchors can be placed and reasoned about. To this end, we employ a VGGT-based [ 28 ] backbone model as a strong multi-view geometry prior.

blocks.en: 3.2 Entropy-Guided Anchor Sampling
blocks.zh: 3.2 Entropy-Guided Anchor取样

blocks.en: An effective allocation should both broadly cover the scene and place more anchors in visually complex regions where finer local representation is needed. To capture such complexity, we compute a Shannon entropy map [ 25 , 45 ] for each input image. We first convert the RGB image to grayscale, quantize the grayscale values into bins, and compute a local histogram within a sliding window around each pixel. The entropy at image location 𝐮 \mathbf{u} is then E ( 𝐮 ) = − ∑ b = 1 B p b ( 𝐮 ) log p b ( 𝐮 ) , E(\mathbf{u})=-\sum_{b=1}^{B}p_{b}(\mathbf{u})\log p_{b}(\mathbf{u}), (1) where p b ​ ( 𝐮 ) p_{b}(\mathbf{u}) is the fraction of pixels in the local window around 𝐮 \mathbf{u} whose quantized grayscale values fall into the b b -th bin. Regions with simple appearance, such as smooth walls or sky, tend to have low entropy, while textured structures and local boundaries tend to have high entropy. We use this quantity as a direct and training-free measure of local visual complexity (shown in Fig. 3 ).

Given the scene points 𝒫 = { 𝐏 v } v = 1 V \mathcal{P}=\{\mathbf{P}_{v}\}_{v=1}^{V} , we construct the anchor set using two complementary steps. We then sample anchors from the full set of scene points with probabilities proportional to the entropy values at their associated image locations, so that more anchors are allocated to visually complex regions. In this way, scene points provide anchor location candidates in 3D, while the final number of anchors is independent of the input resolution and the number of input views.

blocks.zh: 3.3 隐蔽-智能多维锁定聚合

blocks.en: With anchors allocated in scene space, the next step is to encode them for local Gaussian decoding. This differs from pixel-aligned Gaussian prediction, where each primitive corresponds to a single pixel observation from a specific view. In Anchor3DGS , each anchor represents a local 3D region in the scene, and is therefore encoded by aggregating information from multiple views.

blocks.zh: 3.4 对格乌西安的解码和渲染

blocks.en: After occlusion-aware aggregation, each anchor 𝐚 n \mathbf{a}_{n} is associated with an embedding 𝐳 n \mathbf{z}_{n} . We then decode these embeddings into the final 3D Gaussians. Our goal is to keep the overall representation compact while still allowing each anchor to model a sufficiently rich local 3D region in both geometry and appearance. To this end, we decode a set of local Gaussians around each anchor.

blocks.en: 4 Training
blocks.zh: 4 培训

blocks.en:
We train Anchor3DGS on five public multi-view datasets: DL3DV [ 16 ] , ScanNet++ [ 39 ] , Hypersim [ 23 ] , BlendedMVS [ 36 ] , and Waymo [ 18 ] . These datasets cover synthetic and real-world captures, indoor and outdoor scenes, and object-scale to street-scale settings, which enhances the model’s generalization ability to unseen scenarios.
For each training scene, we sample a set of context views as input. For datasets with sequentially ordered captures ( e.g., DL3DV [ 16 ] ), we adopt an index-based sampler that selects two boundary frames at a chosen index gap, and samples additional context views from intermediate frame indices between them. For datasets without a sequential ordering ( e.g., ScanNet++ [ 39 ] ), we instead use a ranking-based sampler that ranks all views by the camera-pose distance (rotation angle and translation) relative to a randomly chosen reference, and then selects context views from this distance-sorted list. In both cases, the extent covered by the selected context views (an index gap or a rank window) is randomized across iterations, producing a mixture of small- and wide-baseline configurations during training.
blocks.zh:
我们训练Anchor3DGS使用5个公共多视图数据集: DL3DV [16], ScanNet++ [39], Hypersim [23], BlendedMVS [36],和Waymo [18]. 这些数据集涵盖合成和现实世界的捕捉,室内和室外的场景,以及从物体尺度到街道尺度的设置,这增强了模型的通览能力以隐蔽情景.
对于每个训练场景,我们抽取一组背景观点作为投入. 对于有相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 对于没有顺序排序的数据集(例如ScanNet++ [39]),我们取而代之的是使用一个基于排名的采样器,该采样器将相机-拥有距离(旋转角度和翻译)相对于随机选择的引用来排列所有视图,然后从这个按距离排序的列表中选择上下文视图. 在这两种情况下,选定的上下文视图(索引差距或排名窗口)所覆盖的范围在迭代之间随机划分,在训练期间产生出一种由小底线和宽底线组合组成的混合.

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Following AnySplat [ 11 ] , we evaluate the novel view synthesis quality on VR-NeRF [ 35 ] and MipNeRF360 [ 2 ] datasets. We also test on a held-out subset of DL3DV [ 16 ] that is disjoint from training. Together, these benchmarks jointly cover object-centric, indoor, and outdoor scenes, providing a comprehensive evaluation.
blocks.zh: AnySplat [11],我们评价了VR-NERF[35]和MipNERF360[2]数据集上的新颖视图合成质量. 我们还测试与培训脱节的DL3DV[16]被搁置子集。 这些基准共同涵盖以物体为中心的室内和室外场景,提供了全面的评价。

blocks.en:
We compare Anchor3DGS against recent pose-free feed-forward 3DGS methods: NoPoSplat [ 38 ] , FLARE [ 44 ] , Depth Anything 3 (DA3) [ 15 ] , and AnySplat [ 11 ] . Among them, NoPoSplat and FLARE are tailored for sparse-view inputs and do not scale to dense-view inputs, so we only include them in the sparse-view comparison (3 and 6 views). In the dense-view setting ( 32 32 views), we also report VGGT+3DGS as a per-scene optimization reference.
We compute PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS between the rendered images and the ground-truth images. To further reflect the compactness of our representation, we also report the number of Gaussian primitives ( #GS ) for each scene.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了Anchor3DGS与近期的无外观回馈3DGS方法:NoPoSplate [38],FLARE [44],深度Anything 3(DA3) [15],AnySplate [11]. 其中"NoPoSplat"和"FLARE"是针对稀有视图输入量而定制的,不以稠密视图输入量为尺度,因此我们只将它们纳入稀有视图比较(3和6视图). 在稠密的视图环境(32个32个视图)中,我们还将VGGT+3DGS报告为人均场景优化参考.

blocks.en:
We set the anchor budget to N = 32,768 N=32{,}768 and decode K = 8 K=8 Gaussians per anchor, yielding roughly 0.26 0.26 M Gaussians per scene independent of input resolution and view count. The dimension of each anchor embedding 𝐳 n \mathbf{z}_{n} is 128 128 , and the dimension of per-Gaussian feature vector 𝐡 \mathbf{h} (used for rendering refinement) is 16 16 .
We initialize the geometry backbone of Anchor3DGS with the pretrained VGGT [ 28 ] weights and fine-tune it jointly with the rest of the network using a 0.1 × 0.1\times smaller learning rate, while keeping the patch-embedding layer frozen. The model is trained on 8 8 NVIDIA H20 GPUs for 30,000 30{,}000 iterations (about 2 2 – 3 3 days). We use the AdamW optimizer with a peak learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} and 1,000 1{,}000 warmup steps. During training, the number of context views per scene is randomly sampled between 2 2 and 16 16 , and the maximum input resolution is set to 448 448 pixels on the longer side. At inference time, all images are resized to 448 × 448 448\times 448 resolution. For the training loss weights, we set λ mse = 1.0 \lambda_{\text{mse}}=1.0 , λ lpips = 0.05 \lambda_{\text{lpips}}=0.05 , and λ depth = 0.1 \lambda_{\text{depth}}=0.1 .

blocks.en: 5.2 Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 量化结果

blocks.en:
We first evaluate Anchor3DGS in the sparse-view setting (3 and 6 input views). As shown in Tab. 1 , our method consistently achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS across all three benchmark datasets. The improvements are most pronounced on MipNeRF360 and DL3DV, where Anchor3DGS achieves PSNR gains of over 2 2 dB compared to the best baseline under each setting.
These gains stem from two advantages of our anchor-based design: entropy-guided sampling concentrates capacity on visually complex regions, while cross-anchor self-attention propagates context to poorly-observed areas, mitigating the holes prevalent in pixel-aligned methods.
Notably, Anchor3DGS achieves these gains with only 0.26 0.26 M Gaussians per scene, showing that a compact anchor-based representation can yield both higher fidelity and greater efficiency in the sparse-view setting.
blocks.zh:
我们首先评价了Anchor3DGS在稀有视图的设定(3和6个输入视图). 如图一所示,我们的方法在所有三个基准数据集中都始终实现了最好的PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS。 这些改进在MipNERF360和DL3DV上最为明显,Anchor3DGS的PSNR增益超过2分贝,而每个设定下的最佳基准值为2分贝.
这些收益来自我们基于锚地设计的两个优点: 肽-导取样将能力集中于视觉复杂区域,而跨指针自觉则将上下文传播到观测不足的地区,减轻了像素相通方法中普遍存在的漏洞.
值得注意的是,Anchor3DGS以每个场景0.26 0.26名高斯人实现了这些收益,这表明以锚地为基础的紧凑代表制在短视环境中既能产生更高的忠诚度,又能产生更高的效率。

blocks.en:
Furthermore, we test Anchor3DGS in the dense-view setting ( 32 32 input views), where the input already provides rich coverage of the scene.
As shown in Tab. 2 , our method provides comparable rendering quality against state-of-the-art pixel-aligned baselines, while requiring an order of magnitude fewer Gaussians and smaller storage footprint. Since the anchor number is decoupled from the input views, our #GS stays at 0.26 0.26 M regardless of view count, whereas pixel-aligned methods produce several million Gaussians with no corresponding quality gain.
The VGGT+3DGS also provides a strong reference but represents a different paradigm—it requires minutes of optimization per scene, whereas Anchor3DGS directly predicts the 3DGS representation from the input views in a feed-forward pass within seconds. Despite this efficiency gap, our method still achieves on-par rendering quality.
blocks.zh:
此外,我们在稠密视图环境(32,32个输入视图)中测试Anchor3DGS,其中输入已经提供了丰富的场景覆盖.
如Tab. 2所示,我们的方法提供了与最先进的像素相通基线相匹配的渲染质量,同时需要数量级的更低高斯人和较小的存储足迹. 由于主播号码与输入视图脱钩,我们的#GS保持0.26 0.26 M不分取景计数,而像素相通的方法则会产生数百万高斯人,没有相应的质量收益.
VGGT+3DGS也提供了很强的参考,但代表着不同的范式——它需要每个场景的分钟最优化,而Anchor3DGS则直接从输入视图中预言3DGS在数秒以内在向后传递. 尽管效率存在这种差距,但我们的方法仍然能实现平地渲染的质量。

blocks.en: 5.3 Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: 5.3 定性结果

blocks.en:
Fig. 4 presents qualitative comparisons under both sparse-view and dense-view settings. In the sparse-view setting, the representative method NoPoSplat [ 38 ] tends to produce overly blurry renderings, while AnySplat [ 11 ] frequently leaves holes in poorly observed regions. Our method alleviates both issues, yielding coherent structure and visually appealing results across different scenes.
In the dense-view setting, our renderings remain on par with the state-of-the-art baselines while using an order of magnitude fewer Gaussian primitives. Our method recovers sharp textures and fine details, and avoids the fragmented, needle-like artifacts commonly exhibited by optimization-based 3DGS pipelines.
More visualization results are provided in the Appendix.

图4列出了在稀有视图和稠密视图背景下的质量比较。 在稀有视野的设定中,代表性方法NoPoSplact [38]往往会产生过于模糊的渲染,而AnySplact [11]则经常在观测不良的区域留下洞. 我们的方法缓解了这两个问题,产生了连贯的结构,在不同场景中产生了具有视觉吸引力的结果。
在密集的视野中,我们的渲染量与最先进的基线相同,同时使用数量级的更少的高斯原始人. 我们的方法恢复了尖锐的纹理和细微的细节,并避免了以优化为基础的3DGS管路通常展示的破碎而像针状的文物.

We conduct the ablation study to validate each key design of Anchor3DGS . Tab. 3 reports results on VR-NeRF [ 35 ] under both sparse-view ( 3 3 views) and dense-view ( 32 32 views) settings. Removing any component causes a quality drop, confirming that all four designs contribute to the final performance. blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We present Anchor3DGS , a pose-free feed-forward 3DGS framework that replaces the prevailing pixel-aligned paradigm with a compact anchor-based paradigm. By placing a fixed number of 3D anchors on a geometry-aware scaffold, our method decouples the Gaussian count from the input resolution and view number, and instead allocates representation capacity according to scene content. Three key designs—entropy-guided anchor sampling, occlusion-aware multi-view aggregation, and feature-based rendering refinement—together enable high-fidelity novel view synthesis. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that Anchor3DGS achieves state-of-the-art rendering quality in sparse-view settings. In dense-view settings, Anchor3DGS attains comparable quality while using an order of magnitude fewer Gaussians and lower storage cost, validating the effectiveness and efficiency of our compact anchor-based representation. Beyond view synthesis, such a compact anchor-based representation naturally serves as a global geometric memory [ 46 ] , offering a promising substrate for future video world models.
blocks.zh: 我们提出Anchor3DGS,这是一个无外观的Feed-forward 3DGS框架,它用一个紧凑的以锚地为基础的范式来取而代之。 通过将固定数个3D锚地放入有几何意识的脚手架上,我们的方法将高斯人计数从输入分辨率和视图数中解开,取而代之的是根据场景内容分配表现能力. 三种关键设计——入门制导锚地取样、闭塞-认知多视图聚合和基于地貌的渲染精细化——共同促成高真实度新视角的合成。 跨越多套数据集的广泛实验表明,Anchor3DGS在稀有视图环境中实现了最先进的渲染质量. 在密景环境中,Anchor3DGS在使用更低的高斯人和更低的存储成本,验证我们以紧凑锚地为基础的代表的有效性和效率的同时,也取得了相仿的质量. 除了取景综合之外,这种紧凑的以主播为基础的代表自然起到全球几何记忆的作用[46],为未来的视频世界模型提供了一个有希望的基础.

blocks.en: Despite the advancements, Anchor3DGS still has limitations. The performance of our method relies on the prediction quality of the geometry backbone. When the backbone produces inaccurate poses or noisy depth maps, the resulting anchor placement may degrade and harm the final rendering. In addition, since the anchor budget is fixed regardless of scene scale, very large or unbounded scenes may benefit from a scene-adaptive budget, which we leave as future work.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了进步,Anchor3DGS仍然有局限性. 我们方法的性能依赖于几何主干线的预测质量. 当主干线产生不准确的姿势或吵闹的深度图时,由此产生的锚地定位可能会降解并损害最终渲染. 此外,由于锚地预算是固定的,不论场景规模大小,非常大或无限制的场景可能会受益于场景调整后的预算,我们离开后作为未来的工作.

blocks.en:
Because our task takes uncalibrated images as input, evaluation must rely on camera poses predicted by the model itself. We follow the testing protocol of AnySplat [ 11 ] .
Given a test scene with context views and held-out target views, we run the model twice: (i) On context views alone, we obtain the predicted context poses 𝒞 ( 1 ) \mathcal{C}^{(1)} and the scene’s 3D Gaussians 𝒢 \mathcal{G} . (ii) On the union of context and target views, we obtain a second set of poses 𝒞 ( 2 ) \mathcal{C}^{(2)} that includes the target views. Since the two passes can produce slightly different context poses, we apply a Procrustes alignment between the context poses in 𝒞 ( 1 ) \mathcal{C}^{(1)} and 𝒞 ( 2 ) \mathcal{C}^{(2)} , and use the resulting transform to map the target poses in 𝒞 ( 2 ) \mathcal{C}^{(2)} into the coordinate frame of 𝒢 \mathcal{G} . We then render 𝒢 \mathcal{G} at the aligned target poses and compute metrics against ground-truth images.
For NoPoSplat [ 38 ] , which does not predict input camera poses, we follow the original protocol and recover target camera poses via a 200 200 -step test-time optimization that minimizes the MSE between the rendered image and the ground-truth image.

blocks.en: The UNet clearly improves rendering quality, while the increase in warping RMSE over the variant without the UNet (consistent reference) is marginal, indicating that it introduces minimal multi-view inconsistency. The reason is structural: the feature map fed to the UNet is rasterized from the same 3D Gaussians with the same alpha-compositing weights as the base image, so the predicted residual inherits the 3D geometric structure of the underlying representation rather than being hallucinated in 2D image space. Furthermore, the enhancement 2D UNet is lightweight, which inherently limits its capacity to introduce multi-view artifacts.
blocks.zh: UNet明显改进了渲染质量,而比没有UNet(一致的参考)的变体增加的Warting RMSE则微不足道,表明它引入了最小的多视图不一致. 原因是结构:提供给UNet的地物图由同同为3D高斯人并有与底像相同的α-相集分量的光栅化而来,因此所预测的剩余部分继承了基础代表的3D几何结构,而不是被2D图像空间所幻化. 此外,2D UNet的增强是轻量级的,这本身就限制了其引进多视图文物的能力。

blocks.en: The results isolate two effects. (i) The backbone contribution — comparing our backbone + pixel decoder against AnySplat [ 11 ] — is small: +0.28 / +0.03 / +0.19 dB on VR-NeRF [ 35 ] dataset and +0.15 / +0.39 / +0.26 dB on DL3DV [ 16 ] dataset at 3 / 6 / 32 views, confirming that fine-tuning the backbone alone does not explain our rendering improvement. (ii) The anchor contribution — comparing Anchor3DGS against our backbone + pixel decoder — is substantial: +2.10 dB (VR-NeRF 3 views) and +3.33 dB (DL3DV 3 views), narrowing to +0.32 / +0.50 dB at 32 views. The performance gain therefore primarily comes from the anchor-based representation rather than the fine-tuned backbone. Unlike pixel-aligned decoders that predict one Gaussian per pixel and leave holes in poorly-observed regions, our anchors aggregate multi-view context through attention mechanism and concentrate capacity in high-entropy regions via entropy-guided sampling.

(二)主播贡献——将Anchor3DGS与我们的骨干+像素解码器相提并论——相当:+2.10 dB(VR-NERF 3视图)和+3.33 dB(DL3DV 3视图),收缩为+0.32 /+0.50 dB,收缩于32视图. 因此,业绩收益主要来自锚地代表而不是微调骨干。 不像像素相通解码器预测出每像素一个高斯人,并在观测差的区域留下洞口,我们的锚点通过注意机制来聚合多视图环境,并通过肽-导取样将能力集中在高通区域.

blocks.en: Appendix C Broader Social Impacts
blocks.zh: 附录C 宽度 社会影响

blocks.en:
Anchor3DGS is a general-purpose feed-forward 3D reconstruction and novel view synthesis method, and we expect its social impact to be generally positive. By predicting a compact set of 3D Gaussians from uncalibrated images in a single forward pass, our method substantially reduces the per-scene optimization cost of conventional 3DGS pipelines. This efficiency lowers the computational and memory footprint of 3D content creation, and also makes high-quality 3D reconstruction more accessible to downstream applications such as virtual and augmented reality, robotics, autonomous driving simulation, and immersive telepresence.
On the other hand, like other photorealistic novel view synthesis techniques, our method could be misused. Realistic renderings of reconstructed scenes might be repurposed to fabricate misleading visual content, and unconstrained reconstruction from publicly available imagery raises potential privacy concerns regarding individuals or private spaces captured in the input views.
These risks can be mitigated through standard practices, including responsible data curation, watermarking or provenance tracking of synthesized content, and obtaining proper consent before reconstructing scenes that contain private property.
blocks.zh:
Anchor3DGS是一种通用的feed-forward 三维再生再生和新颖取景合成方法,我们期望其社会影响普遍为正. 通过从单个前行通道的未校正图像中预测出一组紧凑的3D高斯人,我们的方法大大降低了常规3DGS管线的每地优化成本. 这种效率降低了3D内容创建的计算和内存足迹,也使高品质的3D重建更便于下游应用,如虚拟和增强现实,机器人,自主驱动模拟,和浸入式远程存在等.
另一方面,与其他相片现实主义小说取景合成技术一样,我们的方法可能被滥用. 对重建的场景进行现实的渲染,可能会被重新用来编织误导性的视觉内容,不受限制地从公开的图像中进行重建,引起了对输入观点中所记录的个人或私人空间的潜在隐私关切。
可以通过标准做法来减轻这些风险,包括负责任的数据整理、对合成内容进行水印或出处跟踪,以及在重建包含私人财产的场景之前获得适当同意。
